text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, in an effort to become stronger,
Copano
Rickey begins searching for
Umamusume whose
help she can count
on. However...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What? You want me to help you train? I
know I
said people willing to help are
important, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... I can't help you. I made a
goal-oriented
schedule and there's no
turning back now. I just
don't have the
time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oohoo, you'd like me to help you train?
Well, I'd
be more than happy to.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You would?! Thanks, Acute! ☆ Okay, in
that case,
let's do a scrimmage right
away.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: HRAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Eeep... Trainer, she's way too strong. I can't even keep up with her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute might have a
grandmotherly
demeanor, but she's also
one of the most
prominent powerhouses
you'll see on the dirt
track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's entered around thirty races, and
while she
hasn't won a G1 race yet, she
has come in second
twice. She's also won
three graded races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, she's had some
incredibly close
races against Smart
Falcon, another renowned
dirt racer.
Basically, Copano Rickey isn't ready to

pair run with someone at that level.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So, even if someone agrees to
train with
me, we won't be able to help
each other grow
unless we have a good
dynamic.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think I need to find a racer who either
just
debuted or is close to it...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But I can't think of any runners who can
wield
their full power on the dirt without
any trouble.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neither can I. Hokko Tarumae and
Wonder Acute
are the only two who
come to mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But if it's a special connection we're
looking for...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hints? ...Now that you mention it, I did
see that
my lucky color was black.
choice_data_list: Do you have any feng shui tips?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like that's all we have to go on. I
guess I
could look for students with
black hair or
something...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Rickey!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Kita! Of course! Why didn't I think of
that? ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep! We used to play in the same park
when we
were kids!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Is that true, Kita?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! This was back before I met you,
Dia! Rickey
and I always used to race
each other!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I lost my toys in the sandbox,
Rickey
always found them for me right
away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black is Copano Rickey's
underclassman.
Her kindhearted nature
has earned her the
nickname "clutch
captain".

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The word "Black" is literally in her name.
I called
her out here to see if things
clicked... but it
sounds like they go way
back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And this is Satono Diamond. She's
Kitasan Black's
best friend and the
heiress of the Satono Group.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kita? I'm actually looking for
someone to
train with me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you could be that
someone?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course! If it's help you need, it's help
I'll
give! ♪ And...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm especially happy to be helping you,
Rickey!
You were such a good friend and
play pal when
we were kids!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. ☆ Thinking back on the times
we played
together, and that park, too...
It really takes me
back.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I remember there being so many adults
and older
girls that would look after us.

text_block_list.name: Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I got rid of those dangerous
fences so
you two won't get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Now you can run around without
worrying about
crashing into them.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! They were so good to us. It's
thanks to
them that we got to run
around as much as we
liked!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Kita, let's run together again! Just like
we did
back then!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We'll run as fast as we used to,
like the
good old days back in that park!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, would you mind if I lent my
assistance as
well?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, you too, Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Why, yes. I do believe some training is
easier to
do with three people.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd be delighted to help, if you'll have
me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sure, thanks a bunch, Dia! In that case,
I'm
looking forward to working with you,
too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's best friend, Satono
Diamond,
readily agrees to help out as
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon, the bond between the three of
them grows
stronger with each passing
day.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's make the most of today's session,
too,
Rickey! I've been looking forward to
it since this
morning!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What does today's feng shui look like?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Today's feng shui... "Metal
will clash
with wood." So it looks like
your wood affinity
isn't great today, Dia.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wood isn't great today... In that case!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's run on the woodchip track! Trust
me. I'll be
just fine!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Your feng shui really is amazing, Rickey. It's so reliable!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It really motivates me to overcome the
challenges
it identifies! I just love it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... It looks like she's really taken a
liking to
you...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it kiiind of feels like you're
stealing her
away a little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Satono Diamond's fixation
on
breaking jinxes has helped her and
Copano
Rickey build a great dynamic.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! I think the three of us can
really hit
the dirt running! And it's all
thanks to you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of them form a triad of runners
who
complement each other's training
perfectly.
They're all helping each other
improve.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's hone our running together!
Yeah, let's hone your running together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having forged some new bonds, Copano
Rickey's
horizons have broadened
greatly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home later that day...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh... It's her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey comes to a stop in front
of the
academy gates. I follow her gaze
to see...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A student and her trainer parting ways.

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thank you for everything.

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome. But I'm sad to see you
go. I
never thought you'd leave racing
behind of your
own volition...

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a choice. My injury's healed,
but my
situation's still hopeless... Well,
goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The former student thanks her trainer as
she
leaves. But right then...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey calls out, unable to stay
quiet.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Are you having trouble with your
running? If
you're struggling to stay
optimistic, then...

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: If this is a pep talk, it's half a year late...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: H-half a year?

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
At first, I thought the worries were just
all in my
head, but then my appetite
disappeared... and I
started staying up
too late...

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
My trainer was always there for me, but
then I felt
guilty for dumping all my
problems on someone
else.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh... I see...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Um! In that case!

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I've already found a job.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to use this as an opportunity to
start
over.

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure I just didn't have enough
talent...
and I've accepted that.

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for worrying you. Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A melancholic smile lingers on her face
as she
walks away. Today's far from the
first time I've
witnessed such a scene at
Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There must've been something... I
could've done.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Like, red in the east. She could've
tried
waking up as the sun rose every
morning.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A lot of getting back on track starts with
little
efforts like that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But if I can't reach out and help them, all
I can do
is watch them go. And I've seen
so many go since
I started at Tracen...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to do something to help. Even if
it's not
possible right now, there has to
be something I
can do...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to get stronger and
spread feng
shui! I want to help as many
people as I can, as
soon as possible!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We have to do our best, Trainer!
Together with
Kita and Dia!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Strength for the sake of victory alone
isn't what
interests her—she wants to
build up the kind of
strength that can
support others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In this moment, the fire in Copano
Rickey's eyes is
blazing hotter than the
crimson of the setting sun.
